Description: [EG Patrols] Cloak's native DesignState is DevelopmentOnly (unlike Misty Knight, who was already Live) - flip to Live so our custom interact dialog actually fires instead of falling back to just his native ambient click-through greeting.

[EG Patrols] Hightown teleporter - Ironman Tutorial was abandoned (confirmed live: his model has no mouse-hover/interact collision at all client-side, even after fixing DesignState+DialogText - a client-asset limitation, not a data problem). Doctor Strange's native DesignState is NotInGame (same class of blocker as Cloak's DevelopmentOnly). Confirmed safe to reuse: 0 cell-marker placements anywhere; the 3 prototype-data references are all either dead (SerpentMenSurvival is ActiveInRegions-restricted to a ZZZDevelopment dead room, and the old MysticMayhemChild1 redacted variant is itself DesignState:NotInGame) or cosmetic-only (the live MysticMayhemChild1New event references him only for his icon/name in a StoryNotification popup - confirmed live via a full run of that quest, he's never physically spawned).
